ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Leaning Scrub
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
LEANINGSCRUB_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 9 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md). A flat, wind-scoured plain under a low sun, running unbroken to every horizon under an eerily even canopy of knee-high fuzz — every stand leaning the same way, moving because the wind never stops. It generalizes the biome sketched for a frozen campaign world's own arid shrubland (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/arid_shrubland.md) with zero campaign-specific content: no named factions, no lore proper nouns, nothing that names the source campaign or any franchise.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. It ships its own signature flora — the fuzz that carpets the whole plain, the ancient sweetline trees that mark the roads between settlements, and the two desert-hardy scrub shrubs that hold the thin soil — plus a modest core of non-franchise wildlife. Franchise-specific fauna (Star Wars creatures) never appear in this def; a companion Utinni patch layers 40 of them on top for the campaign that wants the fuller cast, exactly as it does with every other RimMandrake biome mod.
Ships one real behaviour switch, togglable in Mod Settings (default = shipped behavior, MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine):
1. The master toggle: turns this mod's own settings-driven behaviour off without touching the biome def itself — the plain, its plants and its animals keep loading and playing exactly as before. 2. Venomvine thicket passability: whether the shrubland's fortress-flora stands (RM_VenomvineThicket, shipped by the shared RimMandrake: Environmental Hazards kit) block anything above the huge body-size band from entering. Off restores plain pathfinding through every stand on this biome specifically, without touching that kit's own global switch for any other consumer of the same plant.
Also ships the wind calendar (LEANINGSCRUB_MECHANICS_BUILD_1): every ordinary day on the plain carries wind, broken only by the Stall (dead calm; small wild animals hold still) and the Gale (hearing and speech lost outdoors, wind turbines surge with a breakdown risk, raids weigh heavier among threats). Each effect has its own switch in Mod Settings.
NOT in this mod yet: the campaign's tree-guardian creature (SHRUBLAND_TREE_GUARDIAN_1), the vaporator desertification mechanic and the canopy-concealment stat.
